content:
Delighted to have attended the IATA Airline Industry Payment Day in Geneva, bringing together airlines, payment providers, fintechs and industry experts to discuss the future of payments in aviation.
Topics covered included Payment Orchestration, new payment methods, Nexo, ISO 20022, AI-driven payment operations, and IATA’s Retailing transformation initiatives.
A valuable opportunity to exchange insights and explore the future of airline distribution and payments.

#IATA #AirlinePayments #Aviation #TravelTech #NDC #Retailing #PaymentOrchestration #DigitalTransformation #Fintech #Nouvelair
personaInterest: Future of airline distribution and payments
keyTakeaway: Airlines are seeking innovative payment solutions and digital transformation strategies, presenting an opportunity for fintech and travel tech companies to offer their services.
